hints.title: Count Servers per Row and Column
hints.text: Precompute the total number of servers present in each row and in each column of the grid.

hints.title: Check Communication Eligibility
hints.text: A server can communicate with another server if its row server count exceeds 1 or its column count exceeds 1.

hints.title: Sum Communicating Servers
hints.text: Traverse the grid a second time, incrementing the total count for every server meeting the communication criterion.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning the entire row and column for every individual server takes O(M * N * (M + N)) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Pre-aggregating row and column sums solves communication checks in O(M * N) with O(M + N) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that checking if row_count > 1 or col_count > 1 suffices.
complexity.notes: 1 represents a server, 0 represents empty space.
